**Description**

Adding SYNAPTIA (SYNA) token to the official Base community token list. All metadata and SVG logo included.

topContributors.summary: joshklop: Focused on enhancing the stability of the `optimism` repository by merging PR #19550, which involved a small but impactful change to op-acceptance-tests, and also opened PR #19551. Their code changes, spanning 84 files with a net increase of 3745 lines, primarily focused on tests and other development work, with a smaller portion dedicated to bug fixes.

ajsutton: Focused on improving CI stability and efficiency, merging a PR to remove a problematic rust-e2e variant in ethereum-optimism/optimism (#19553) and opening two additional PRs to quarantine a flaky test and upgrade a resource-intensive CI job. Their code changes primarily focused on bug fixes, with significant modifications to test and configuration files.

Angelges: Today, Angelges opened a PR to add the SYNA token to the Base List (ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io#1287), modifying 2 files with 969 additions, indicating a focus on configuration work.
